def grid_of(fr):
    g = {}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['pixels']==4: g[(r0,c0)] = n['color']
    return g
before = grid_of(current_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':26}, {'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':38}])
after = grid_of(current_frame)
print("result:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','reward','score')})
diff = [(k, before.get(k), after.get(k)) for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)) if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)]
print("diffs:", diff)
print("Y:", [k for k,v in after.items() if v=='Y'], "O:", [k for k,v in after.items() if v=='O'])
print("ring cells:", after.get((28,15)), after.get((28,45)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
